lessons.story:
SATURDAY SKILL EXCHANGE: Teach a short skill and learn another. Each approved fifteen-minute teaching session earns one learning credit after it is completed. Offering a session on the sign-up sheet does not earn credit immediately. The coordinator must confirm that it took place.

One credit books one learning session, regardless of the number of minutes you previously spent preparing. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred to another person. You may attend several sessions if you have enough credits and the times do not overlap.

New participants receive one starter credit so they can try learning before teaching. Unused credits remain available for next month's exchange. If a teacher cancels a booked session, the learner's credit is returned. Please check the updated timetable on Friday; the list printed earlier in the week may no longer show the final rooms.
